text:
Will Chen: Heads up — noticed two customer invoices got corrected this week because token counts arrived late. Looks like delayed usage batches from the metering pipeline.

Jamie Patel: Which accounts? any recurring pattern?

Will Chen: Accounts: acme-corp, fintech-co. Delays around 2026-03-12 02:10 UTC and 2026-03-19 01:45 UTC. Spike correlates with retry window on ingestion queue. Export: s3://redwood-metering/delays/2026-03/manifest.csv

Arik Gomez: I can take the investigation (logs + pipeline root cause) but need an owner for billing corrections and customer comms. @Maria Ruiz are you available?

Maria Ruiz: I can own invoice corrections and customer outreach. Timeline?

Will Chen: Plan suggestion: Arik = technical remediation & RCA, Maria = invoice corrections + customer comms, Jamie = recurrence analysis + alerting/SLO changes. Targets: investigation within 48h, alerting in 3 days, config fix in 2 weeks, billing corrections before next billing run.

billing-bot: Autonotice: Invoices corrected for acme-corp (ADJ-8842), fintech-co (ADJ-8843) — adjustments queued.

Arik Gomez: Quick findings: consumer lag on metering-collector (kafka consumer group). Relevant log excerpt:

```
2026-03-12T02:09:58Z ERROR metering-collector consumer lag=12034 group=collector-main - kafka read timeout
java.time.TimeoutException: Read timed out after 30s
  at ...
```

Repro steps I ran: `kubectl logs -l app=metering-collector --since=2h | grep consumer_lag`
Suggested short-term mitigation: reduce `max.poll.records` from 500 -> 200 and increase commit frequency. Will QA in dev then roll to prod during low traffic window.

Will Chen: Also add an alert: ingestion lag > 5m or >5000 msgs should go to #eng-infra and page oncall. Jamie can you add that to Prometheus/Alertmanager?

Jamie Patel: Yep. Adding alert rule now: `alert: MeteringConsumerLagHigh` expr: `sum(kafka_consumer_lag{group="collector-main"}) > 5000` for 5m. Will add dashboard tile and link to postmortem.

Jamie Patel: I'll run historical scan to check recurrence. SQL I used to pull delayed batches: 
```
SELECT date_trunc('week', ingestion_time) as wk, count(*) as delayed_batches
FROM metering.events
WHERE processed_at - ingested_at > interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY wk
ORDER BY wk DESC
LIMIT 12;
```

Maria Ruiz: Draft for customers: "We discovered delayed ingestion of usage data which caused token counts to be posted late. We've corrected the counts and applied credits ADJ-8842/8843. We're implementing monitoring to prevent recurrence." I'll send first batch of outreach by EOD Thursday, cc support and billing-ops. Need legal?

Will Chen: Legal review not required for routine credits, but include support ticket links and attach the ADJ IDs. Also update the public billing FAQ with a blurb about late metering corrections.

Arik Gomez: Action items (I'll paste here for clarity):
1) Investigate Kafka consumer backpressure + fix config and deploy (owner: Arik Gomez) — due 2026-04-06
2) Add Prometheus alert + dashboard tile (owner: Jamie Patel) — due 2026-03-25
3) Process invoice corrections + customer emails (owner: Maria Ruiz) — due 2026-03-26
4) Postmortem writeup + recurrence analysis (owner: Jamie Patel & Will Chen) — due 2026-03-29

Will Chen: I've added this to the postmortem tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PM-789 (please attach links to artifact and the S3 export).

Jamie Patel: I'll also schedule a 30m sync early next week if Arik needs help reproducing. :thumbsup:

Maria Ruiz: Sending first batch of emails now. Email template saved to /docs/billing/delayed-metering-email.md.

billing-bot: Adjustment processed: ADJ-8842 status=completed at 2026-03-23T14:12:03Z, ADJ-8843 status=completed at 2026-03-23T14:12:07Z

Will Chen: Good. Keep this thread updated with any customer responses or new findings. Let's watch for similar spikes the following two billing cycles to confirm remediation.
